# Phoenix feather icon

`logo_icon.svg` is Phoenix's feather icon, offered as `phoenix-icon.svg` ("Feather Icon") on the phoenix-xi.com media
page. Copied unchanged from the phoenix-platform repository, `apps/launcher/src/assets/logo_icon.svg`, at commit
888cc6b1 (last changed in 5e24e851).

phoenix-platform has no license file and this is Phoenix's brand mark: confirm with the Phoenix team before
publishing it. `tools/gen_shapes.py` flattens its outline into the polygon HeadsUp draws as the feather cursor; the
SVG's drop shadow is not used.
